keepouts.note: Panel FPC folds around the E board edge here. Edge_Cuts has a 1.5 mm x 18 mm recess (x 38.5-40, y 6-24) so the folded flex stays inside the 40 mm outline. Nothing in the housing may clamp or rub this band.
Flex runs W from the fold to the 13-pin solder pads centred at (26.78, 15) on the MCU side. The board keeps this corridor component-free; housing columns must too.

notes: Board 40x30, verified against the production Edge_Cuts gerber + PCBWay placement CSV + KiCad PCB (2026-07-23, first physical modules in hand). ORIENTATION - this is the only noknok module whose payload sits on KiCad's BOTTOM side: the TFT panel is bonded to the bare B side and its 13-pin FPC wraps around the EAST board edge to solder pads on the F side (F carries the MCU, boost, both JST-SH sockets). All coordinates here are the PAYLOAD view (origin = bottom-left corner looking AT the screen) = the KiCad top view mirrored in Y (v' = 30 - v_kicad_top), the same convention the buzzer/knob/ledbutton profiles use. Consequence: J2 is on the N edge at y=26.9 in this frame even though KiCad and the README describe it as the S edge. clearance_top=2.2: the bonded panel stands 2.08 mm proud (measured by Christopher); the extra 0.12 mm keeps the cover bezel from pressing on the glass. top_feature window = the 32.35x16.18 ACTIVE area; the glass (36.52x18.08) is ~2.09 mm larger per side in X and ~0.95 mm in Y, so the cover bezel overlaps and frames it. Window centre x=19.8 and the glass position are still UNMEASURED - confirm with calipers now that boards exist, the Y bezel is only ~0.95 mm so a Y error eats it fast. clearance_bottom=3.0 = JST-SH SM04B-SRSS-TB body 2.95 mm, the tallest MCU-side part (confirmed by Christopher). Connector exit directions derived from the footprint geometry: signal pads sit at footprint-local y=-2 and the mating opening at local +y, so with KiCad's global = origin + Rot(-theta) * local every socket opens straight off its nearest board edge - J1 west, J2 north (payload frame). All four M2.5 holes clear the glass (glass spans y 5.96-24.04, holes at y 2.25 / 27.75), so the front cover can use posts at every corner - no collar needed. Mounting-hole reference: the (2.25, 2.25) corner is the noknok_FlashPads_I2C-module_1x3_M2.5 footprint (flash pads around the same M2.5 hole), the other three are plain noknok_MountingHole_2.5mm_M2.5.
